acceptanceCriteria: Pressure re-sample: the recovery path re-samples host/process pressure before clearing the marker, or the spec records why it is unnecessary (CAL-V0-226..229).
dispatch recover-reader emits an observable event (or Tasks receipt) for the operator recovery, and the attestation is a native journal entry or the spec records why a state-dir record suffices.

Live qualification: a real dispatcher run on this host exercises HOLD, refused start, recover-reader, then start; Linux boot-identity auto-recovery is executed on Linux (CI or host) with retained evidence.
body: Residuals of V1-0710 / GitHub #899 from PR #908 (change c06be8609, docs/build-log/2026-10-14-gh-899-900-dispatch.md). V1-0710's three ACs are met by the fsynced attestation, the recover-reader command and focused tests; the lane charter's extra items remained: (d) pressure re-sample not done; operator path emits no event; attestation is a state-dir record, not a native journal entry; live dispatcher qualification and Linux boot-identity execution NOT_RUN. Codex minor kept as a limit: a missing relative --config path is reported missing rather than MALFORMED (V1-1386).
title: dispatch recover-reader residuals: pressure re-sample, recovery event, journal attestation, live and Linux qualification
